_doc: Revert-verify for the action-pin-drift guard (issue #4487): one version per pinned GitHub Action across all of .github/, workflows AND nested composite actions — the surface Dependabot's github-actions ecosystem does not scan. Axes D1-D8 live in check-action-pin-drift.test.ts; the subject is the guard script itself. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this spec> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout. Recorded runs: see the PR body.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/scripts/check-action-pin-drift.mjs

M1_scan_workflows_only._why: Models the Dependabot blind spot exactly: a guard that only looks at .github/workflows. This is the defect #4487 is about, so D1 (drift living in the composite action) MUST red here.

M2_group_by_full_path._why: Groups by the full action path instead of the owner/repo release unit, so sibling sub-actions out of one repo (github/codeql-action/init vs /analyze) stop being compared.

M3_uses_matched_as_substring._why: Strips the start-of-line anchor, turning the `uses:` key read into a substring match. This is the mechanism that actually carries comment immunity: unanchored, a commented-out step (`# - uses: actions/x@v4`) is read as a live pin, so the guard reds on a correct tree. ⛤ An earlier mutant here deleted a `line.trimStart().startsWith("#")` filter instead and reddened NOTHING — no comment line can reach the regex while it is anchored, so that filter was dead and was removed from the guard.

M4_zero_pins_is_clean._why: Removes the population floor: files scanned but zero pins matched would report a clean bill of health instead of BROKEN.

M5_count_docker_digests._why: Removes the container-image exclusion, so a digest-pinned docker:// ref is read as an Actions pin and two digests of one image red a correct tree.

M6_drift_check_never_fires._why: Makes the drift predicate unsatisfiable while leaving every count, message and exit path in place — the guard still prints its OK line. Every drift-detecting axis must red.

M7_empty_tree_is_clean._why: Removes the other BROKEN branch (no yaml found at all). It is a separate code path from M4's, so it needs its own mutant.
